what: Integrated Claude fleet panel with reproducible task plans and ten-table availability checks
why: Run selected or all test tables without silently reducing the batch; show individual measured outcomes and inline recordings
details: Nine fleet server tests, four routing tests, four planner tests and two main server tests pass.

Deployed a target selector and shared prompt: Table 1 is the main table; Tables 2–11 can run individually or all ten in parallel. Explicit typed targets override the selector visibly; invalid targets are rejected.
Removed the legacy three-camera section. Verified all ten correctly framed idle images at 320 pixels wide, with capture ages of 1–3 seconds, after the independent capture history fix.

Submitted ten randomized tasks from the browser: seed 1453311647, request c45502194a2746a4a41bea810a8a72be. There were 84 API attempts, 49 returned actions and seven tables with motion. No held pickup passed: nine errors and one failed objective.
All ten MP4 recordings loaded in the browser. Table 3 playback advanced from 0.29 to 11.62 seconds of an 18-second video. Restored all ten fresh live previews afterward.
A UUID worker lease and atomic command claim prevent duplicate execution. Actual capture timestamps distinguish fresh previews from stale images.
